paragraphs.text:
“One minute Bernard was lying by the fire, unconscious, like you left 
him. The next minute he was gone,” Norman says. “We followed 
his tracks to the river. As far as we can tell, they go in and don’t 
come out.” A search of the area confirms his report. You can do 
nothing further.

To head back to the fort, go to 324. To continue exploring, despite 
this, go to 600.
